title: Build a CLI with a --verbose mode
problem: My command line tool is either silent or drowning in console.log, the diagnostics land on stdout where they break every pipe, and when a run fails I cannot tell which stage went wrong or how long it took.
outcome: A working sync command that is quiet by default, prints labelled and timed stages under --verbose, reports the failing stage at any level, and keeps stdout clean enough to pipe into jq.

knowledge: An empty directory to build the command in
